Controls

👆Swipe — roll one tile. Swipe and hold — keep rolling
⤒Tap — jump. Tap, then swipe in the air — jump onto a step or over a gap
⏫Press and release — squash and jump two floors up
💨Press and swipe — dash: smashes rocks, walls and doors
⬇In a jump, swipe down — slam: breaks planks and soil, digs out what's buried
🪨Granite takes three hits. A dash knocks a crate away
🧗Next to a wall in the air, tap — kick off it. Not twice off the same wall
🟪Sticky walls and ceilings: roll any way. Tap — let go, press and release — jump off
◠A stuck cube rounds bevelled corners smoothly — roll sideways along the wall
🎲Material pads: rubber bounces high, paper floats and flies on the wind, wood floats on water
🟫Mud sticks to walls, but wears off with every step and dries if you hang still
◟A clean cube slides down curved ramps; a muddy one climbs. A dash carries you up, an ice ramp launches you
🧊On ice the cube slides until it hits something: swipe to turn, tap to jump
▱You can roll up a quarter-block step; anything higher takes a jump
🕳To enter a cave, roll into the arch in the rock
♥Three lives. After a loss you return to the last safe spot; out of lives — the level restarts
🏖Sand and snow sink you in — no dash, but a slam clears snow. Quicksand swallows you if you stand still
🌊In a lake with a bottom concrete rolls along the lakebed; in bottomless water it sinks
🏞A river carries you downstream — jump ashore before the waterfall. Wind carries paper
🌋Lava: paper burns, rubber melts, concrete overheats, wood catches fire — get off in time
⚙Traps: cracked tiles collapse, spikes pop up, blocks shove you off the path
🎁Push a bush or tree, smash a rock — some hide a star or an extra life
✨Stars can be buried: slam down nearby and it pops out
🍂A heap of leaves, sand or stones or a crate may hide a tile. Slam down next to it
❄A snowdrift or dune blocks the way — break through with a dash. Something may be buried under it
◆Break a granite rock — its stone stays on the cube's corners: it rolls on ice without sliding and climbs icy ramps
🚇Under a low roof (a bridge, a plank, a niche in the rock) the cube can't roll — dash in, inside a swipe slides it along. Into a niche at jump height — swipe in a jump. A cracked block in the rock may hide a tunnel
⛏Some secret places hide their entrances where you'd least expect. Their stars count for the level
🏮Dark lanterns light up when you bump them, but not for long. Light them all before the first one goes out — and something will open
⛲A geyser erupts now and then and throws the cube up to its height; at the top, swipe aside. A rock on its vent chokes it — push it off
★Every 10 stars give an extra life that stays with you. Each star counts only once
👻A finished level remembers your finds: counted stars show as ghosts and don't count again
🏺Find every star and secret on a level and you get its artifact — a relic of an old culture
❄Look closely, and you may find someone who has been in this world for a very long time…
✌️Two fingers: rotate, pinch, drag — camera. Camera button: swipe sideways — turn, up or down — zoom, hold and drag — move the view, tap — back onto the cube
⚠At the edge of a drop, a short swipe only tilts the cube — swipe longer to step down
⛰A fall of three floors smashes the cube. Ice and steep scree are slippery
Keyboard: arrows/WASD — roll, Shift+arrow — dash, Space — jump (hold to charge), X — slam, Q/E — rotate, +/− — zoom, R — restart, Esc — menu
Controller: stick or D-pad — roll, A/✕ — jump (hold to charge), hold A/✕ or X/□ and push the stick — dash, B/○ in a jump — slam, right stick, LB/RB, LT/RT — camera, Y/△ — back onto the cube, Start — menu, Select — locations, touchpad — like the screen (swipe, tap, hold)
